sentence:
For positive rational numbers $a_i$:
$\frac{a_1 + \ldots + a_k}{k} \geq \sqrt[k]{a_1 \cdots a_k}$
Substituting the given conditions, we get:
$\frac{n}{k} \geq \sqrt[k]{n}$
Raising both sides to the power $k$:
$\left(\frac{n}{k}\right)^k \geq n$
$\frac{n^k}{k^k} \geq n$
$n^{k-1} \geq k^k$
sentence-category-reason: Applies AM-GM and performs algebraic steps to derive n^{k-1} ≥ k^k.
